reason: Add bounded, redact-by-allowlist CI failure diagnostics for existing Windows-only A22 contract failure without bypassing any suite, runner status, or canonical control.
physicalImpactJustification: Diagnostic-only output on failing governance test runner; no runtime, production backend or Android code modified.
compatibilityRisk: CI Windows root cause remains unknown until GitHub-run diagnostics. This does not certify remote Prebuilt or native attestation. Failure remains exit 1.
restrictions: Local-only diagnostic gate; no implicit Git commit, push, merge, main change or deploy.
Safe bounded control names and error classes only; no raw stdout/stderr logging.
Preserve all 125 previous regression controls and 14 suites; keep fail-closed behavior.
No Android, package version, backend, Vercel, historical receipt, workflow or A2.1 script mutation.
